records.jp: 風が……泣いている……
ふっ、私たちイノセントヴァーミリオンの<CR>門出に世界がカタストロフィを感じてるようだな……
records.en_original: Indeed. Heh, it's almost like the world itself feels the catastrophe that is fast approaching...
records.en: Heh.<CR>It appears the world senses catastrophe at the departure of Innocent Vermilion...

records.jp: 風が……鼻で笑ってる……
風に馬鹿にされた！？
きゅ、急にどうしたのきらら
愛央にはきこえないのか……！<CR>この泣きごえが！！
records.en_original: You can't hear it? This sadness...?
records.en: Can you not hear it, Ao!?<CR>This weeping voice!

records.jp: き、聞こえないけど……
あ、わらいだした
とおもったら今度はおどってる
踊ってる！？
むっ、次はふおんな風が吹いてきた
records.en_original: Hmm, now the wind is telling me to beware...
records.en: Hm. An ominous wind is blowing next.

records.jp: ふ、不穏な風が吹くとどうなるの……？
ふおんなことが起きる
具体的には気球がばくさんする
不穏どころじゃない！！
ばくさんまで、十、九……
records.en: Ten seconds until it explodes. Ten, nine...

records.jp: そんなすぐに！？<CR>え、えっと、えっと、こんなときはまず――
records.en_original: That soon?! U-uh... What are you supposed to do at a time like this again?
records.en: That soon!?<CR>U-um, um, at a time like this, first...

records.jp: ま、まずは落ち着いてきらら慌てたら助かるものも<CR>助からなくなるよゆっくり深呼吸して水を飲んで
records.en_original: F-first you should calm down—there's no saving you if you're panicking! Deep breaths... And drink some water!
records.en: F-first, calm down, Kirara. Panicking will make it impossible to save anyone,<CR>so breathe slowly and drink some water...

records.jp: み、みみずがない！？　しょ、しょうがない、<CR>み、水なしでもおちついてきらららら！
records.en_original: Th-th-there's no water! That's okay, you'll just have to calm down without water, Kirararara!
records.en: Th-there is no water!?<CR>F-fine, calm down without water, Kirararara!

records.jp: きららは落ち着いてるぞ
えーあー爆散するってことは爆発するってことで<CR>そうだ対爆防御だ目を閉じて口を大きく開けて――
records.en_original: Uhhh, uhh, let's see... Popping means an explosion, so you should close your eyes and open your mouth to protect yourself from the shockwave...
records.en: U-um, exploding means an explosion, so... right, blast protection!<CR>Close your eyes and open your mouth wide...

records.jp: 目を閉じたら何も見えない！？！？<CR>で、でででも落ち着いてきららららら
records.en_original: But then you won't be able to see anything?! I-i-it's okay, don't freak out, Kirararara!
records.en: If you close your eyes, you cannot see anything!?<CR>B-but calm down, Kirarararara!

records.jp: きららはずっと落ち着ているぞ
records.en: Kirara has been calm this whole time.

records.jp: お、おおおおちつけ、おちつくんだ私。<CR>私が取り乱すと横にいるきららららも不安になっちゃう
records.en_original: Aaaalright, don't freak out, Ao. If you don't stay calm, Kirararara will get scared.
records.en: C-c-calm down. Calm down, me.<CR>If I panic, Kirararara beside me will get nervous too.

records.jp: らが二つ多い
よ、よよよよし。お、おちついてきた気がするる。<CR>さぁ、きららららら飛び降りるよつかまって！！
records.en_original: Ooookay, I think I feel better. We're jumping Kirarararara, hold onto me!
records.en: O-okay. I-I think I'm calming down.<CR>Kirarararara, we're jumping! Hold on to me!

records.jp: おお、らがさらにふえた
ごめん愛央、気球がばくさんするのは嘘
records.en_original: I'm sorry, Ao. I was just kidding about the balloon popping.
records.en: Sorry, Ao. The balloon exploding was a lie.

records.jp: な、なんだ嘘か……よかった……
ほんとは愛央がばくさんする
records.en_original: You're the one who's going to be popping.
records.en: The truth is that Ao will explode.

records.jp: きらららららららららら
というのも嘘。実は何もばくさんしない
records.en_original: Just kidding. Nothing is going to pop.
records.en: That was a lie too. Nothing will actually explode.

records.jp: な、なんだ何も爆散しないのか……よかった……
って、じゃあ何でそんな嘘ついたの？<CR>なんかきらら今日、はじめから様子がおかしいし……
records.en_original: Why do that? You've been acting strange all day...
records.en: Then why did you tell a lie like that? You've<CR>been acting strange since the beginning today...

records.jp: 誰の目もない、二人っきりの空だから、<CR>愛央といっぱいふざけてみたかった……
records.en_original: We don't get much time alone, I wanted to have fun with you...
records.en: Because we are alone in the sky with no one watching,<CR>Kirara wanted to fool around with Ao as much as possible...

records.jp: ダメ、だった……？
きらら……
ぜんっっぜんだめじゃないよ！　私も楽しかったし！
records.en_original: Not at all! I had a ton of fun!
records.en: Not at all! I had fun too!

records.jp: それなら、よかった
と、ところできららもさっきみたいなセリフ好きなの？<CR>風が泣いてる、とか……
records.en_original: You're a fan of that occult sounding stuff, huh? "The wind is weeping..." kind of thing.
records.en: B-by the way, do you like lines like the ones from earlier too, Kirara?<CR>Like, 'The wind is weeping'...

records.jp: 人生で言ってみたいセリフランキング六十五位だった
records.en_original: It was 65th on my list of cool lines I want to say.
records.en: It was sixty-fifth on Kirara's ranking of lines she wants to say at least once in her life.

records.jp: わ、私も！　私もそのランキング作った！<CR>ベスト百まであるやつ！
records.en_original: I-I have one of those too! A top 100!
records.en: M-me too! I made that ranking too!<CR>One with a top one hundred!

records.jp: ふっ、きららのはベスト三百ある
records.en: Heh. Kirara's has a top three hundred.

records.jp: 定期的にこようか、ここ
うむ
悪しき邪眼の封印は今まさにジャッジメントされた……<CR>今宵、この船は世界のルールさえ乗り越える……！
records.en_original: We have sealed the Evil Eye here today and brought retribution... This ship will cut its way through the world itself!
records.en: The seal on the wicked Evil Eye has now been judged...<CR>Tonight, this vessel will transcend even the rules of the world...!

records.jp: あ……あお？
ふっふっふ、聞こえるかきらら？　――風の声が
records.en_original: Heheh... Can you hear it, Kirara? The wind?
records.en: Hehehe. Can you hear it, Kirara? The voice of the wind.

records.jp: ！！　聞こえる……きららにも聞こえる……
records.en_original: I can...! I can hear it too...
records.en: !! Kirara can hear it... Kirara can hear it too...

records.jp: これは――
風が――
――泣いているッッ！
フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
